'''Flameow''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Nekoflare]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Flameow regards everyone with cool indifference and a touch of disdain. Everyone except [[Kittazap]], who's earned a modicum of respect."

Flameow is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, dark gray-blue cat that wears a red collar with an orange orb that has a flame symbol on it. Its inner ears and the end of its tail are fiery red. It also has yellow eyes with red pupils, and the lower half of its face is white. Its two upper fangs are visible even with its mouth closed.

Flameow's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with bright pink, and its gray-blue fur becomes gray-teal.

== Evolution Trial ==
Flameow's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Nekoflare]] you need to complete the following task:

* Clear 10 [[Battle|stages]] with Flameow and Kittazap together.

==Strategy==
[[File:Flameow Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Flameow's attack range]]
You should use Kittazap/evo alongside Flameow because of the Paw Pals bond.
{{clear|left}}

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Flameow is a fire Tatari because rock and water wouldn't vibe with Kittazap. Grass, well, that would just be weird."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Flameow sneers at everyone but Kittazap. The flaming tail flares to varying degrees depending on the amount of disdain held towards you."
